name: Today, I Woke Up Again
source:
You play as Faith, a relatively depressed young man who’s going through a tough time. Do your best to help him escape his perpetual listlessness!

[From [url=https://himebee.itch.io/today-i-woke-up-again]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演费斯，一个相对抑郁的年轻人，正在经历一段艰难的时期。尽你最大的努力帮助他摆脱永远的无精打采！

[来自[url=https://himebee.itch.io/today-i-woke-up-again]itch.io[/url]]
